uint32.tooltip: Next object in the parent's child list.

uint32.name: Child Handle
uint32.tooltip: First child object (a biped's first child is its weapon).

uint32.name: Parent Handle
uint32.tooltip: Object this one is attached to (-1 = none).

uint16.name: Placement Index
uint16.tooltip: Index of the placement in the scenario (0xFFFF = not from one). Written by CreateObject.

point3.name: Bounding Center
point3.tooltip: Center of the bounding sphere (NOT the origin; ~half body height above it). Not written by CreateObject.

point3.name: Saved Bounding Center
point3.tooltip: Copy of the sphere center kept by FUN_180479888.

float32.name: Saved Bounding Radius
float32.tooltip: Copy of the sphere radius kept by FUN_180479888.

point3.name: Origin
point3.tooltip: Object position (feet level for a biped). Copied from the placement.

vector3.name: Angular Velocity
vector3.tooltip: Copied from the placement (+0x4C); no other access seen.

uint32.name: Placement Id
uint32.tooltip: Unique placement id (counter when the placement has none).

uint16.name: BSP Index
uint16.tooltip: BSP index of the placement.

uint8.name: Object Type
uint8.tooltip: Type index (0 bipd, 1 vehi, 2 weap ... see the type definition table). Used by RunComponentInitializers.

uint8.name: Placement Origin
uint8.tooltip: 2 = dynamic (created at runtime); matches table entry +4.

uint8.name: Placement Team
uint8.tooltip: Byte copied from the placement (team candidate).

uint32.name: Attached Entry Handle
uint32.tooltip: Handle into another table (stride 0xC0, unidentified). Read by weapon/biped updates.

flags32.name: Object Flags 2

uint16.name: Model Variant
uint16.tooltip: Variant index (starts 0xFF). Old name: HlmtVariant.

uint32.name: Owner Player Handle
uint32.tooltip: Player that owns the object (-1 = none).

uint32.name: Owner Biped Handle
uint32.tooltip: Biped that owns the object (-1 = none).
